job_description:
Junior Data Engineer

Our data team moves data from operational systems into a cloud warehouse. You will write SQL and Python jobs, model tables with dbt and load them into Snowflake.

Responsibilities:
- Build and monitor daily data pipelines.
- Write tested SQL transformations in dbt.
- Document data sources and support analysts with data questions.

Requirements:
- Python and strong SQL.
- dbt and Snowflake.
- Git.

Nice to have: Airflow for orchestration.
